name: Jesuit Refugee Service (JRS)
story: Every **{programmes: cost_total / (people_reached + edu_people + liv_people + pro_people + mhp_people + hea_people)|$}** serves one refugee with schooling, emergency aid, legal help, counselling and health care.
summary: A Catholic organisation of the Society of Jesus, founded in 1980, that accompanies, serves and advocates for refugees and other forcibly displaced people: schools in refugee camps and host communities, livelihoods, emergency aid, legal advice and protection, mental health and psychosocial support, pastoral care and reconciliation, in 57 countries through ten regional offices and an international office in Rome. It served 1.09 million people in 2025. Modelled on the network-wide financial statement in its 2025 annual report.

spending.source: https://jrs.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/JRS-Annual-Report-2025-ENG.pdf (Annual Report 2025, Financial Statement pp. 32-33, in US dollars as published: programmes $83.9m of total expenditure $93.6m; management and administration $7.5m and fundraising $2.2m excluded. A network-wide summary of all JRS offices, not stated to be audited: each regional office is financially autonomous, and the international office's own audited accounts (Crowe Bompani, latest 2023) cover only projects coordinated from Rome.)
